reviewed_by: Claude review of ranking connected servers alongside tools in Jev suggestions
reason: tool_suggestions.py stops asking Jev the two gate questions and instead ranks the selected MCP servers in the same call as the tools. build_questions now emits sources_<i> choice questions built by source_criteria() -- a server's label plus the instructions it returned at the MCP handshake, or its tool names when it returned none -- and interpret_answers returns a JevRanking carrying per-tool probabilities, per-source probabilities and the none_of_these probability of each tool's question. rank() multiplies a tool's probability by a bounded prior from its source (floor 0.5, so a source can halve a tool's score but never silence it, and a tool whose source was not ranked stays at full weight), keeps at most MAX_PICKS=3 tools, and preloads at most two of them -- only those that also beat their question's none option, which is what now stands in for the removed gate. chat.py passes mcp_sources(mcp_profiles) and copies the ranked source labels into CatalogReceipt.source_hints; catalog_instructions names them in the per-turn text. test_tool_suggestions covers the handshake-instruction and tool-name descriptions, a source rank deciding which of two equally rated tools is preloaded, the three-pick cap, the none option holding a schema back without hiding the hint, and the prepare path recording source_hints; test_tool_catalog re-runs because it shares that fixture and owns catalog_instructions.
exclusions: No frontend unit tests and no UI change: ToolSuggestionChip reads status/preloaded/suggested, which keep their meaning, and the new sources key is ignored by the client type until a chip mockup is approved. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No screenshot baselines: no rendered surface changes. Playwright is area:tool-suggestions only (its four catalogued entries, 7 tests). The impact rules would also pull area:assistant, area:chat-edit-in-place and area:provider-thinking for chat.py, but the change there is three lines inside the Jev-only block that neither the chat stream, message editing nor thinking rendering touches; area:core-api is excluded because no request or response schema changes -- the turn snapshot and the chip payload only gain optional keys. tests/v3/test_chat.py, test_chat_api.py and test_mcp_probe.py were run locally (76 passed) and are excluded as unaffected.
